title: Sum the Even Numbers
description: Return the sum of all even numbers in the list. Return 0 when there are no even numbers.

boundary_comparison: Parity is about divisibility by two, including zero.
Check the condition used to classify a number.
An even number leaves no remainder after pairing.
Trace zero, one, and two before a mixed list.
off_by_one: Each input number should be considered once.
Trace the first and last positions in a mixed list.
Check whether the loop visits every element.
Put the only even number at each end and in the middle.
unhandled_short_input: No numbers is a valid input.
Start with the sum contributed by no even numbers.
An empty list should not need a first element.
Compare empty, one-number, and mixed inputs.

explanations.exact_boundary: Zero is even, although adding it does not change the total.
explanations.normal: Only values divisible by two should contribute to the total.
explanations.short_input: A one-item list still needs the parity rule applied.
explanations.empty_list: With no numbers, the even-number sum is zero.
